notes: Phobos Medical economy: price, work, repair bill, salvage and where the Ward-3 is sold. Priced above the vanilla Infirmaway (18,570) for its powered care, patient handling and drawer; work and the repair bill follow the Infirmaway's own (install and uninstall 1300, repair 2000, dismantle 1500; motor, mainboard, clean cloth, small parts and scrap). Salvage must weigh what the bed weighs (92 kg). Sold where the game sells its own medical bed: the furnishings kiosks. Player files in BepInEx/config/PhobosMedical/economy override entries by name.

PhobosMedicalBed.notes: Halewright Ward-3 Medical Bed, 3 x 5, 92 kg.

offerTemplates.notes: K-Leg furnishings kiosk, which sells the game's own medical bed, sells new Ward-3 beds.
K-Leg supply kiosk sells broken beds.
Venus scrap kiosk sells refurbished beds.

regional.notes: Regional supply kiosks offer the bed at baseChance times the region factor, as for the other Phobos equipment; the flotilla sells refurbished. Mars Volatile's medical station region (MVOL) is weighted highest.

worldLoot.notes: A rare find, like the damaged Infirmaway in the game's own random parts: one engineering-salvage roll in fifty, three in four broken.

factionKiosks.notes: The Ward-3 at the CCRE and GalCon faction kiosks for scrip. Equipment from 10,000 credits is Friendly (docs/development/faction-kiosk-stock.md); nothing at Honored.
